what: 2 x 4 x 5 gender x age x race joint quota table, N=18,000
method: iterative proportional fitting (raking) of a census-seeded table to the benchmark preregistration's two published two-way margins
margin_source: Silicon Sample Benchmark preregistration, Table 3 (2024 Census Bureau Population Estimates Program cross quotas, rescaled to N=18,000)
seed_source: age composition within each racial group for US adults 18+, shaped to published median ages by race/ethnicity (White non-Hispanic ~44, Asian ~37.5, Black ~35, Hispanic ~30)
reconciliation: the two published margins disagreed by one person on the gender total (8,827 male from the age table vs 8,828 from the race table). White non-Hispanic male 5,332 -> 5,331 and female 5,500 -> 5,501: the White total and every other published cell are unchanged.
verification: both two-way margins reproduce exactly at the person level; grand total 18,000
caveat: the age x race association is NOT determined by the published margins. It comes from the seed, so it is an informed estimate rather than a benchmark-supplied quantity. The margins are exact; the interior is modelled.
